nota: Bloque 1.1. Tema de decide 30-oct: 'earnings' (alza 1->48; Reddit/Roblox descartados: la caída de Q3 no se pudo verificar). Cifras: Amazon 8-K ex. 99.1 Q3 2026 (29-oct, sec.gov): ventas $201.9B (+12%), AWS $46.0B (+39%, crecimiento más rápido en casi 5 años), beneficio operativo $28.1B, AWS $17.8B, Norteamérica $8.7B, Internacional $1.6B, margen 13.9% récord. 46.0/201.9 = 23%; 17.8/28.1 = 63% (cálculo propio).

frases.texto: Twenty-three percent of Amazon's sales. Sixty-three percent of its profit.
That's not the store. That's AWS, Amazon's cloud business.
This quarter Amazon sold two hundred one point nine billion dollars.
AWS brought in forty-six billion, up thirty-nine percent.
Its fastest growth in nearly five years.
Here's the part nobody tells you.
Of twenty-eight billion in operating profit, AWS made seventeen point eight.
The whole North American store made eight point seven.
Amazon is quietly a company that rents out computers.
So sixty-three percent of the profit: are you buying a store, or a cloud?

frases.texto: Two hundred one point nine billion dollars in sales. That's not where Amazon makes its money.

ganchos.texto: Amazon's most profitable product isn't anything you can put in a cart.
Sixty-three percent of Amazon's profit came from something you never see.

contraste.nota: Una idea (la nube paga, la tienda vende) con la paradoja 23% vs 63% en el segundo 0; 'nobody' revela la cifra en dólares.

error.nota: Mito claro, pero el gancho con $201.9B es una cifra grande sin contraste; la paradoja llega a los 15 s.

contraste+g1.nota: Intriga sin cifra; la paradoja se pierde.

contraste+g2.nota: Buen misterio, pero esconde el 23% que hace el contraste.

contraste+g3.nota: Cifra en dólares sin escala: menos clara que 23/63.
